notes.title: August 5, 2025 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug preventing bosses from properly absorbing blood at lower framerates

Increased sound and mouse sens increments in the options menus to 5 and 0.05 respectively

Fixed a bug where skipping the last cutscene through the pause menu would skip the credits

Fixed a bug that made the mouse cursor visible during the credits

These changes have also been applied to the demo version of the game.
